title: GitHub issue reports
notes: Report Issues opens a pre-filled GitHub issue again. Review it and press Submit new issue to send it to the developer.

title: Playable on public
notes: Report Issues is now playable on the public build: describe an issue in-game and open a pre-filled GitHub issue.

title: Reports send in-game
notes: Report Issues now prepares a GitHub issue with the game build and page details included.

title: Report Issues
notes: The main menu now has a Report Issues clipping. Describe what happened and open a pre-filled GitHub issue to send it to the developer.

title: Build 0.1.1
notes: Tutorial: a new save asks if you want it. A drill at Site 9, a small research facility, with a short note and a caution-tape box for each control. The fight stops while you read, notes can be dragged out of the way, and the drill ends with a horde nobody can hold.
The war board points out its buttons the first time you open it.
Playing as a soldier on a touch screen: a thumb stick walks him, he always fires on his own, and your finger only aims.
An eye button at the top middle hides the bottom controls for a clear view.

A clock button drops down the game speeds, with Pause beside it (press Pause again to carry on). The next-wave button reads Call Wave (15s), and each wave is announced as a short line instead of a big banner.
Soldier dossiers show icons for damage, range, fire rate and health. Phone controls along the bottom are a fifth smaller, and the main menu too.
The end-of-fight report scrolls on a phone with its buttons always in reach. Menu now asks before it leaves.
Fixed a stuck pinch that made dragging the map zoom in and out. Screen changes no longer flash back to the old screen first. The installed app offers a reload when an update arrives.
Pressing the build label in the menu swaps it between the build code and the date.
Skill tree: a soldier's demo is cleared from memory when closed, and the menu game rests while one plays. A page left open across an update reloads itself instead of crashing.
